bholdeasyplace.generic.comment.holdEasyP:
Continuously triggers Easy Place without holding the use key.
Requires Easy Place mode to be enabled.
bholdeasyplace.generic.comment.lenientIt:
Lets Easy Place accept server custom items.
An item counts as a match when its base item is right.
Items that need exact data, like filled shulkers, stay exact.
bholdeasyplace.generic.comment.skipPickB:
If what you hold already matches the target,
Easy Place leaves your hotbar alone.
bholdeasyplace.generic.comment.protectCu:
Pick block never moves another item into a slot
that holds a server custom item.
bholdeasyplace.generic.comment.customIte:
Warns when a server custom item leaves your inventory
and is not given back within two seconds.
The warning and the log line carry a timestamp for tickets.
bholdeasyplace.hotkey.comment.holdEasyPl: Toggles Hold Easy Place mode on/off
bholdeasyplace.message.watchdog_loss: §c%s was not given back after leaving your inventory. Possible item loss at %s.§r
